lock_mode_before.meaning: the pool's lockMode value set by the Guardian to 3 before the checked action

rebase_oracle_pack_performed_unlock.meaning: rebaseOraclePack performed the unlockPool action (the forbidden unlock)

pool_exposed_to_continual_attack_observe.meaning: the pool is exposed to continual attack that the onlyGuardian lockMode 3 was meant to prevent

assumptions: The Guardian's lockMode 3 setting is the onlyGuardian protection against continual attack.
rebaseOraclePack is the action that must not perform the unlockPool action.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call rebaseOraclePack or whether it is permissionless; the authorization guard is expressed only as rebaseOraclePack not performing the unlockPool action.

limitations: The impact is encoded as a Boolean observable because the report states exposure to continual attack qualitatively without a numeric definition.
The authorization relation is expressed as rebaseOraclePack not performing the unlockPool action, per the frozen intent text.
